title: Credentials outside the source code, in an environment variable
context: The system accesses the GitLab REST API with an access token.
decision: Read the credentials only from an environment variable. If the variable is missing, fail with an explicit error.
consequences: It satisfies QS-secrets. The configuration must be documented so that other people can reproduce it.

alternatives.option: A versioned configuration file with a read-only token
alternatives.rejected_because: Any token in the repository violates the scenario QS-secrets, which accepts zero occurrences

sensitivity_points: security: exposure surface of the credential
